req.title: Reject player with duplicate squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when the squadNumber in a new player already belongs to another player.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-008 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when a POST /players/ request carries a squadNumber already owned by another player. The test suite must cover: (1) a positive case confirming a genuinely new squadNumber is accepted with 201; (2) a negative/EP case confirming an existing squadNumber yields exactly 409 with the documented detail message; (3) a boundary case using the lowest pre-loaded squadNumber (1) to confirm the duplicate check fires at the edge of the roster; (4) a DT case combining a duplicate squadNumber with otherwise-valid payload to confirm the conflict check is independent of other fields; (5) a STC case verifying the state transition: first POST succeeds (201), second POST with same squadNumber fails (409), confirming idempotent rejection. All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_new_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squadNumbers 1-26
squadNumber 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squadNumber=99
expected: Response body contains a valid UUID id field
trace: R-PLAYER-008: happy-path — unique squadNumber must be accepted
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile, shutil
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_new_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

test_post_new_squad_number_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_then_duplicate_state_transition
preconditions: Database does not contain squadNumber=50 before the test
expected: First POST returns HTTP 201 with squadNumber=50 in body
Second POST returns HTTP 409 with detail 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-008: STC — state transitions from 'squadNumber absent' (201) to 'squadNumber present' (409)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_then_duplicate_state_transition():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "lastName": "Transition",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Right Winger"
    }
    r1 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert body1["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert body1["firstName"] == "State"
    assert body1["lastName"] == "Transition"

    r2 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r2.status_code == 409
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert body2["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

test_post_then_duplicate_state_transition()
